summary.oneLiner: SETL completed its transformation into an integrated turnkey solutions provider with FY26 revenue up 26.7% to INR 793cr, though Q4 margins dipped to 15.5% due to commodity inflation and preemptive hiring. The INR 1,000cr order book and upcoming INR 130cr capex (targeting INR 4,000cr total capacity) position the company for accelerated FY27 growth, leveraging new Japanese tech partnerships and subsidiary synergies.

financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 793cr (+26.7% YoY); Q4: INR 231cr (+35% YoY). EBITDA: INR 138cr (+15.2% YoY), Margin 17.4% (Q4: 15.5%, down from ~17-19% prior quarters due to metal price hikes and manpower investment). PAT: INR 83cr (+21% YoY), Margin 10.5%. Order Book: >INR 1,000cr (approx. INR 30cr exports, rest domestic). Net Debt: Not explicitly stated, but working capital days improved to 150 from 174; Operating Cash Flow positive at INR 45cr. One-offs: Q4 margin pressure from raw material costs and strategic hiring for future scale.
guidance: Revenue Growth: FY27 expected to be 'better' than FY26 (>26.7%), with quarterly run-rate targeting INR 250-300cr. Margins: Expected to improve in FY27 (>17.4%) driven by operating leverage and solution-mix. Order Inflow: Healthy pipeline, export revenue doubled in FY26, expected to grow further. Capex: INR 130cr over 2 years (INR 65cr in FY27) for Greenfield; INR 35-40cr for brownfield modernization.
order book & pipeline: Total >INR 1,000cr; Execution timeline 8-10 months. Exports constitute ~INR 30cr currently. Subsidiary C2C holds INR 46-47cr. Mix skewed domestic (>95%).
segment / subsidiary detail: Glass-Lined: Core profit driver, ~30% of revenue mix but transitioning. New Products: Shell & Tube Glass-Lined Heat Exchangers (200 units in OB, 100 delivered, local mfg starts July 2026 @ 200 units/month capacity). Bioprocess: Scigenics contributing ~INR 20cr in FY26, targeting INR 60cr in FY27. Engineering: C2C contributed INR 24cr in FY26, targeting INR 60cr in FY27.
growth verticals / optionality: Greenfield 36-acre campus (Phase 1 Apr 2027, Phase 2 Apr 2028) adds INR 2,000cr capacity; Brownfield modernization adds another INR 2,000cr; Total target capacity INR 4,000cr. Entry into Nuclear, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage sectors. Pre-cast building capability to accelerate turnkey project timelines to 6-12 months.
margins & cost dynamics: Q4 Gross Margin declined to 32% (from 39% in Q3) due to metal price volatility and upfront hiring. Management guides margin recovery in FY27 via operating leverage, higher value-add 'solution' selling vs pure equipment, and procurement discipline.
capex / expansion: FY26: INR 40cr. FY27 Plan: INR 65cr (Greenfield) + INR 35-40cr (Brownfield automation/robotics). Total 2-year outlay INR 130cr for Greenfield.
capital allocation: Focused on capacity expansion (Greenfield/Brownfield) and inorganic growth (integration of Scigenics/C2C). No dividend/buyback commentary; reinvestment mode for scale.
risks & watch-items: Raw material (metal) price volatility impacting short-term margins. Execution risk on large turnkey projects. High inventory levels (INR 438cr, though <180 days aging) tying up working capital. Geopolitical delays in export shipments.
management quality / tone: Highly confident, emphasizing 'best year in history', structural transformation complete, and long-term ambition. Aggressive on capacity and global expansion (Japan+India model).
non-obvious takeaways: Shift to 'pre-cast' civil construction to avoid traditional EPC delays and maintain high-speed project delivery (6 months for blocks). Explicit entry into Nuclear sector confirmed. Japanese ED appointment signals deepening of tech-transfer and global sales channel beyond just sourcing.

themes.title: Capital-goods & machine-tool import-substitution
themes.need: Atmanirbhar machine-tool and heavy-engineering localization is supply-constrained against import-substituting demand. JYOTICNC runs >100% utilization with a INR4,732cr order book and near-triples capacity; ELGIEQUIP/CUMMINSIND/ELECON/LMW ride the same capex + export + China+1 pull; ISGEC/BHEL/GMMPFAUDLR/KIRLPNU on process + energy capex.
themes.driver: Capacity expansion going live (JYOTICNC); defence/EMS order conversion; US-reshoring export demand (ELGIEQUIP).
